title: Replace a bicycle brake pad
learner_outcome: Replace one rim-brake pad on a bicycle, then verify the brake by hand before riding, following the manufacturer's manual.

time_estimate.rationale: A single task; no attainment estimate is made because completion is verified, not learned.

objectives.title: Identify the correct replacement pad for the brake model
evidence_criteria: Matches pad model to the manual

objectives.title: Remove the worn pad without damaging the caliper
evidence_criteria: Pad removed with the correct fastener

objectives.title: Seat and tighten the new pad to the manual's specification
evidence_criteria: Fastener tightened to the manual's torque

objectives.title: Verify the brake by hand before riding

sections.title: Identify the pad
sections.lesson_intent: Match the pad model to the manufacturer's manual before touching the brake.

sections.title: Remove the worn pad
sections.lesson_intent: Remove the worn pad with the fastener the manual names, without damaging the caliper.

sections.title: Seat and tighten
sections.lesson_intent: Seat the new pad square and tighten the fastener to the manual's specification.

sections.title: Verify by hand
sections.lesson_intent: Run the manual's hand-verification checklist before any ride.

exclusions: Does not certify the procedure; authoritative manufacturer documentation and an expert check are required.
No live-road test is part of this brief.
Not for hydraulic, disc or e-bike brake systems.
